notes.title: Under the Rainbow 2022 Update
notes.content:
Hi,

I know its been a while since I posted anything new on the game. Truth is I put the game down because I had other stuff to so. I've been working on it on and off for the past year and It's now in a good place that I'm proud off.

I've added new environments, new scenes, new characters, new character models  and more. A new examine system, new conversation system and more.

I'm uploading new screenshots to show the new character models and new characters.

Anyone interested in demoing the game should contact me. I need the feedback.

There is no new trailer yet. 

Thanks.
